# apple_app_store_version_localization (Resource)

Sets an App Store version's localized description, keywords, URLs and release notes for one locale. A new version starts with copies of the previous version's localizations, and the primary locale always has one: creating this resource for an existing locale manages it. Destroying the resource deletes the localization while the version is editable, and otherwise leaves it. Import it with `<version_id>/<locale>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_app_store_version_localization" "en_us" {
  version_id  = apple_app_store_version.ios.id
  locale      = "en-US"
  description = "Example keeps your examples in one place."
  keywords    = "example,demo"
  support_url = "https://example.com/support"
  whats_new   = "Bug fixes and performance improvements."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `locale` (String) Locale, e.g. `en-US`.
- `version_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the App Store version, e.g. `apple_app_store_version.example.id`.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the app, up to 4,000 characters.
- `keywords` (String) Comma-separated search keywords, up to 100 characters.
- `marketing_url` (String) URL of the app's marketing website.
- `promotional_text` (String) Promotional text shown above the description, up to 170 characters.
- `support_url` (String) URL of the app's support website; App Review requires one.
- `whats_new` (String) Release notes for the version, up to 4,000 characters. The first version has none.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the localization.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_app_store_version_localization.en_us
  identity = {
    version_id = "1234567890"
    locale     = "en-US"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `locale` (String) Locale, e.g. `en-US`.
- `version_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the App Store version.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_app_store_version_localization.en_us 1234567890/en-US
```
